command:
set -eo pipefail
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH
cd /tmp
CRAM=https://s3.amazonaws.com/1000genomes/1000G_2504_high_coverage/data/ERR3239334/NA12878.final.cram
echo '== chr20 out of the published 30x CRAM, decoded against chr20.fa =='
# Only chr20 records are touched, and our chr20.fa has the same M5 the CRAM was
# compressed against (b18e6c531b0bd70e949a7fc20859cb01), so a chr20-only reference decodes it.
samtools view -T chr20.fa -b -@ 8 -o raw.bam "$CRAM" chr20
RAWB=$(stat -c%s raw.bam)
echo "raw_bam_bytes $RAWB"
test "$RAWB" -gt 300000000
echo '== restrict the header to chr20, through SAM text =='
# The CRAM header carries 3366 contigs; GATK requires the reads' sequence dictionary to match
# the reference's, and this reference is chr20 alone. But a BAM record stores a NUMERIC index
# into the @SQ list, so `samtools reheader` with @SQ lines removed leaves every read pointing at
# the wrong contig -- measured: `samtools index` then dies with "Numerical result out of range".
# SAM text stores the contig NAME, so a text round-trip makes samtools re-resolve tids against
# the new header. Read groups (12, SM:NA12878) and SO:coordinate survive; HaplotypeCaller needs both.
samtools view -h raw.bam | awk '$1!="@SQ" || $2=="SN:chr20"' | samtools view -b -@ 8 -o NA12878.chr20.30x.bam -
samtools index -@ 8 NA12878.chr20.30x.bam
SQN=$(samtools view -H NA12878.chr20.30x.bam | grep -c '^@SQ')
RGN=$(samtools view -H NA12878.chr20.30x.bam | grep -c '^@RG')
SORT=$(samtools view -H NA12878.chr20.30x.bam | awk '/^@HD/ && /SO:coordinate/{print "SO:coordinate"}')
NREC=$(samtools view -c -@ 8 NA12878.chr20.30x.bam)
samtools coverage -r chr20 NA12878.chr20.30x.bam > cov.txt
DEPTH=$(awk 'NR==2{print $7}' cov.txt)
COVPCT=$(awk 'NR==2{print $6}' cov.txt)
BAMB=$(stat -c%s NA12878.chr20.30x.bam)
SHA=$(sha256sum NA12878.chr20.30x.bam | cut -d' ' -f1)
{
  echo "sq_lines        $SQN  want 1 (chr20 only, to match the reference)"
  echo "read_groups     $RGN  want 12 (HaplotypeCaller requires >=1)"
  echo "sort_order      $SORT  want SO:coordinate"
  echo "records         $NREC"
  echo "mean_depth      $DEPTH  want >=25 (a real 30x sample)"
  echo "pct_covered     $COVPCT  want >=99"
  echo "bam_bytes       $BAMB"
  echo "bam_sha256      $SHA"
} > prep-check.txt
cat prep-check.txt
cat cov.txt
test "$SQN" -eq 1
test "$RGN" -ge 1
test "$SORT" = 'SO:coordinate'
awk -v d="$DEPTH" 'BEGIN{exit !(d>=25)}'
awk -v c="$COVPCT" 'BEGIN{exit !(c>=99)}'
test "$BAMB" -gt 300000000
rm -f raw.bam
echo 'PREP CHECK PASSED'
